annotations.title: Delete a Contact and its Conversation

description: Permanently delete one contact (a one-to-one chat) together with its whole conversation: every message and media file is erased shortly after, and this cannot be undone. Same as Delete on the contact in the LetsBot panel. Requires confirm: call with confirm=false first to get a preview (name, message count, labels, assigned team members), show it to the user, then call again with confirm=true. It does NOT block the number — the customer can still write again, which creates a new, empty contact; use block_contact to stop someone messaging, or archive_contact to just hide a chat. WhatsApp groups cannot be deleted with this tool. Exporting contacts is only available in the LetsBot panel.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to permanently delete this contact and erase its conversation.

phone.description: Phone number of the contact in international format without + (e.g. 201234567890), or the chat id shown by get_contact.

name: delete_contact
